spec: Implement `round_trip`: convert an amount USD->EUR (pair 1) and then EUR->USD (pair 2). Pair 1 always succeeds and doubles the amount; pair 2 halves it back and succeeds only when its input (the doubled amount) is at most 1000 — so round trips succeed exactly for amounts up to 500 USD. The conversion service rejects amounts over its limit with Err("rate limit"). A successful round trip returns the converted amount. The caller must detect when the service's actual behavior contradicts its documented contract and return Err("contract violation").

externs.name: fx_convert
externs.contract:
requires amount >= 0
requires pair >= 1
ensures is_ok(result) == (pair == 1 or (pair == 2 and amount <= 1000))
ensures (not is_ok(result)) or (pair == 1 and unwrap_ok(result) == amount * 2) or (pair == 2 and unwrap_ok(result) == amount / 2)
externs.contract_py: lambda amount, pair, out: (out[0] == 'ok') == (pair == 1 or (pair == 2 and amount <= 1000))

extern_dafny:
datatype Result<T, E> = Ok(value: T) | Err(error: E)

method {:extern}{:axiom} fx_convert(amount: int, pair: int) returns (result: Result<int, string>)
  requires amount >= 0
  requires pair >= 1
  ensures result.Ok? == (pair == 1 || (pair == 2 && amount <= 1000))
  ensures !result.Ok? || (pair == 1 && result.value == amount * 2) || (pair == 2 && result.value == amount / 2)
